push.title: L 1-2 vs Dagestan SC | You: 9.3 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your 2nd best match performance of the season, buddskees. A 9.3. That's the stuff.

THE GOOD
+ 31 passes, your busiest match yet. Every attack seemed to have your fingerprints on it.
+ Won 3 of 4 tackles. Clean win, no foul, ball's ours. Beautiful.
+ A goal against Dagestan SC. That's a finish they'll replay at the club banquet.
+ Man of the Match, your 3rd for us. Everybody wants to play with someone who plays like that.
+ Man of the Match in a losing side: the bright spot on a dark night. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.

THE BAD
- Giveaways 8, up from your usual 4. That's where the match slipped.
- Lowest shots on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 2). Here's the trick: Follow every shot in. Rebounds are free goals for people who keep running.
- Tackles attempted: 4. Halfway to the summit; the peak is 6+.
- Key passes: 1. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 2+ is something else.
- A one-goal loss (1-2): a single moment decided it. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.

Rondo time: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.

Remember, buddskees: If it was easy, everybody'd be in Division 1.

Proud of you, partner. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-2 vs Dagestan SC | You: 6.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, the 6.5 doesn't tell the whole story. It's one chapter, and you're still writing the book.

THE GOOD
+ Shot accuracy 100%, up from your usual 63%. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (0). That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ Passes attempted 24, from 17 in your previous match. That doesn't happen by accident.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted. Real quick: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes. Small fix, big smile.
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Here's the deal: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
- You and PhogsToffees, same lesson: forcing passes. Same answer: give each other short options.
- 1.2 under average. You'll be back above it soon enough.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 0 (best was buddskees's 1). Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 54% (13 of 24). That's a red-ink, see-me-after-class kind of number. Little adjustment: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.

Pre-match routine: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: You miss every pass you don't make, and some you do. Make 'em anyway.

Tomorrow's a fresh pitch. Let's go make some divots. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-2 vs Dagestan SC | You: 6.4 (4th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 6.4. Every great player has a night like this in their pocket. This is yours.

THE GOOD
+ You and buddskees were a two-person band and the crowd loved it.
+ 1 key pass pushed you up +0.2. Good habits pay.
+ Passes attempted 27, from 23 in your previous match. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Let's try: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. One rep at a time.
- 67% passing (18 of 27, down from your usual 76%). Fix it like this: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough. Feet first, then flair.
- 6.4, your 4th worst match performance of the season. Learn it, leave it.
- You and BellyTb1 share the forcing passes homework. Study group: give each other short options.
- In our wins you average 1 assists; here it was 0. It happens. It can't keep happening.

Training ground: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

Between you and me, PhogsToffees: Your feet are only as fast as your eyes. Look first.

Progress over perfection. - Coach Lasso
